messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: runtime-pool-3 throughput anomaly. 20% of pods returning OOM/killed by OOM killer in the last 12m. Paging I/O on nodes reported above baseline, CUDA driver warnings observed. tags: #paging #oom #runtime
alyssa: seeing the same on grafana. Swap/paging spikes correlate with increased srv latency. A few client 503s reported.
devin: logs show repeated 'CUDARuntimeError: out of memory' in runtime logs + kernel dmesg has 'oom_reaper' on containerd shim.
maria: which model/variant? could be large kv-cache for long chats. Checking request traces.
alyssa: most failures originate from model rdl-v2-13b-quant-paged; sequence lengths high (~4k) for some sessions. KV cache footprint creeping.
sam: paging spike on node i-0a12... listed in node exporter: page faults/sec x6. nvidia-smi shows persistent allocations stuck in processes that are dead? attaching excerpt: ```
PID      GPU-Mem
12345    12288MiB
12347    12288MiB  (zombie?)
```
devin: sounds like allocator fragmentation + leaked GPU buffers after container exit. We saw similar 'stuck CUDA allocations' previously when paged-attention switched pages.
alyssa: immediate mitigation: reduce max-concurrency on pool to 2 and enable aggressive kv eviction for rdl-v2-13b-quant-paged. Will route new requests to rdl-v2-13b-quant (non-paged) as fallback.
oncall-bot: @alyssa you are now the incident lead. Please provide impact summary every 15m.
alyssa: doing: applied concurrency limit, updated routing policy to prefer non-paged variant for new sessions. Kicked offending pods for a rolling restart.
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: rollout/runtime/pool-3 - restart 8 pods serially. ETA ~6m.
maria: customer impact: three customers (acct: coresearch, docsynth, chat-lite) reported degraded latency and intermittent 503s between 12:03-12:18 UTC. No data exfil.
devin: collecting heap snapshots from a restarted pod: `gcore` output shows orphaned GPU allocations held by `pagalloc` context. Stack traces include: ```
pagalloc::free_impl+0x1c3
pagalloc::evict_page+0x7f
runtime::serve_request+0x2a1
```
alyssa: temporary config pushed to runtime: `paged_attention.max_retained_pages=4`, `kv_cache.eviction_threshold=0.6`. Also enabled `allocator.force_clean_on_shutdown=true` on restarts.
sam: post-restart metrics look better. GPU mem stabilized on nodes that were restarted. Paging I/O dropped to baseline.
devin: but I'm still seeing slow mem creep on one node. Might be kernel-level fragmentation or a driver bug causing delayed release to NVIDIA. Opening ticket with infra to look at driver logs.
alyssa: escalation decision: need eng-runtime to reproduce leak in staging and verify `force_clean_on_shutdown` actually frees device memory on container stop. Assigning to @devin and @maria for debug runbook.
oncall-bot: handoff scheduled: @alyssa -> @sam for next 2h. Please ack.
sam: ack. summary for next oncall: root cause suspected = paged-attention allocator fragmentation + leaked GPU buffers during container shutdown under heavy prefix caching + long seq lengths. Mitigations applied: lowered concurrency, forced kv eviction, rolling restart + routing fallback to non-paged variant. Customer impact: degraded latency, intermittent 503s to a small subset of customers, all mitigated. Next steps: reproduce in staging, add robust allocator free path, add metric for orphaned GPU allocations.
oncall-bot: @sam you are now oncall lead.
maria: reproduction plan: create long-session load with synthetic prefix expansion, toggle paged-attn on/off, run repeated container kills to validate allocator reclaim. Will capture `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY` and `dcgm` traces.
devin: also will try `--nvml-timeline` with patched driver; if driver shows delayed free, escalate to infra.
alyssa: note for postmortem: consider changing default routing to prefer non-paged variants when seq_len > 2048 until allocator leak is addressed.
sam: will file incident ticket + assign to eng-runtime (priority P1 for bugfix, P2 for long-term perf tuning). Include timeline and mitigation steps.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INCIDENT-2026-1284. Owner: eng-runtime. Claimed by: devin.
alyssa: leaving runbook notes in the incident doc: commands used for mitigation: ```
# limit concurrency
redwoodctl runtime update-pool pool-3 --max-concurrency 2
# force eviction
redwoodctl runtime set-config rdl-v2-13b-quant-paged --kv-eviction-threshold 0.6
# restart pods serially
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime-pool-3 -n redwood --max-unavailable=1
```
devin: follow-up items: 1) add allocator metrics (retained_pages, orphaned_gpu_bytes), 2) add safe shutdown hook to free NVML allocations, 3) load-test non-paged fallback to measure cost delta.
sam: thanks team. I'll monitor for regression and update status in 30m. If anyone sees new OOMs, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
alyssa: thanks all — handing off logs/traces + heap dumps to eng-runtime ticket.
oncall-bot: Incident closed for oncall handoff. Please move to postmortem when root cause confirmed.
